newsitem.title: CHINA: China airlines carry 10 pct more people in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China airlines carry 10 pct more people in 1996.

text.p: The number of passengers carried by China's airlines is expected to rise to 56.5 million in all of 1996, up 10 percent from 1995, the China News Service said on Tuesday.

Cargo and postal shipments by civil airlines in 1996 were expected to rise about 14 percent to 1.15 million tonnes, the agency quoted Bao Peide, deputy director of the Civil Aviation General Administration of China, as saying.
Air freight would rise on a tonne-km basis to 8.5 billion tonne-km in the year, up 14 percent from 1995, Bao said.
China had set a target of carrying 80 million passengers a year and increasing freight turnover to 12 billion tonne-km by 2000, Bao said, but gave no further details.
